answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 13483 Country: India Title: as salaam maulana please give me dua or surah against poisones snake which are roaming near our house immaidety? Question: as salaam maulana please give me dua or surah against poisones snake which are roaming near our house immaidety? Answer ID: 13483 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 919/919=M/1430) Recite the below mentioned dua in the morning and evening 11 times with durood 11 times before and after: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ س لام علی نوح فی العالمین Also, recite the following dua thrice every morning and evening: بسم اللہ لایضر مع اسمہ شئ في الأرض ولا في السماء وھو السمیع العلیم Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
